lines.zh: 八条腿踩在湿沙上，走得很响。
lines.en: Eight legs on wet sand, and every step is loud.

lines.zh: 我横着迈步，比直行还快些。
lines.en: I walk sideways, faster than I'd go straight.

lines.zh: 海水退下去，我去捡湿处的东西。
lines.en: The tide pulls back; I search the wet ground.

lines.zh: 背上这只椰子壳比我还大。
lines.en: This coconut shell on my back is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 沙子粘在关节上，我边走边抖。
lines.en: Sand sticks to my joints; I shake as I walk.

lines.zh: 我沿着浪线走，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I follow the foam line; there's food there.

lines.zh: 一步一停，我在听沙里的动静。
lines.en: Step, pause — I'm listening inside the sand.

lines.zh: 壳太重，我走得歪歪斜斜。
lines.en: The shell is heavy, so I waddle off-balance.

lines.zh: 我的大钳拖在地上，划出一道痕。
lines.en: My big claw drags, scoring a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 涨潮线往上，我得走快点。
lines.en: The tide line is rising; I should hurry.

lines.zh: 沙蟹见我过来，全钻回洞里。
lines.en: The little crabs see me and vanish into holes.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块礁石，钳子先探过去。
lines.en: I round a rock, feeling ahead with my claw.

lines.zh: 从椰子堆到海边，我熟得很。
lines.en: From the coconut pile to the shore, I know the way.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可这壳替我挡了不少。
lines.en: I'm slow, but this shell has taken many blows.

lines.zh: 我先挪开脚下的贝壳，再迈腿。
lines.en: I nudge a shell aside, then take a step.

lines.zh: 椰树影挪过来，我顺着影走。
lines.en: The palm's shade moves, and I walk with it.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上，壳盖住整个背。
lines.en: I lie in the sand with my shell over my back.

lines.zh: 钳子举一会儿，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I hold a claw up, then let it sink.

lines.zh: 海风把盐吹到我的关节上。
lines.en: Sea wind blows salt onto my joints.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水，退潮就有吃的。
lines.en: I wait for the tide; low water means food.

lines.zh: 壳里有点闷，我把头探出来。
lines.en: It's stuffy in here; I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 眼睛动了动，沙上什么都没有。
lines.en: My eyes shift; there's nothing on the sand.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨钳子，发出咔的一声。
lines.en: I rub my claws together; they click once.

lines.zh: 一只海鸥落下来，又飞走了。
lines.en: A gull lands, then flies off again.

lines.zh: 椰子壳里的味道，我不讨厌。
lines.en: I don't mind the smell inside this coconut shell.

lines.zh: 热沙烫着我的腿，我往里挪挪。
lines.en: The hot sand stings; I shift inward a little.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我又被推回半寸。
lines.en: A wave arrives and shoves me back half an inch.

lines.zh: 我用小钳理了理嘴边的须。
lines.en: I tidy the bristles by my mouth with a small claw.

lines.zh: 整片海滩只有我在动。
lines.en: On this whole beach, only I am moving.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，一浪比一浪高。
lines.en: I count the waves; each one climbs higher.

lines.zh: 你站那么高，我得仰着看。
lines.en: You're standing tall; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 我的钳子能夹断椰子的梗。
lines.en: My claw can snap a coconut's stem.

lines.zh: 你脚边的影子，像块礁石。
lines.en: Your shadow by my feet looks like a rock.

lines.zh: 别把手放低，我会去夹。
lines.en: Don't lower your hand; I'll pinch it.

lines.zh: 你身上没有海的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of the sea at all.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的鞋，觉得它能撬开。
lines.en: I stare at your shoe, thinking it could be pried open.

lines.zh: 要不要看看我壳上的纹路？
lines.en: Care to see the pattern on my shell?

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才把钳子放下。
lines.en: Step back once, and I'll lower my claw.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的鱼，别晃。
lines.en: I know that fish in your hand; don't wave it.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也不先动。
lines.en: We watch each other; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scar appears on my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只听外面的声。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and just listen.

lines.zh: 这一下打在壳上，我没事。
lines.en: That one hit the shell; I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，朝打我的方向。
lines.en: I raise my claw toward whoever hit me.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一点，我听见了。
lines.en: The shell cracked a little; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，又转回身。
lines.en: I back two steps, then turn around again.

lines.zh: 八条腿有点乱，我稳住。
lines.en: My eight legs tangle; I steady myself.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，壳还能再挡几下。
lines.en: It hurts, but the shell can take a few more.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，贴紧了沙。
lines.en: I press myself low against the sand.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖壳，沙落了一地。
lines.en: I shake my shell and sand falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 那是椰子吗？我的钳子想试试。
lines.en: Is that a coconut? My claw wants to try.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味从你手里飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of fish drifts from your hand.

lines.zh: 我先走近一点，就一点。
lines.en: I'll come closer — just a little.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在沙上，我就信你。
lines.en: Set it on the sand and I'll trust you.

lines.zh: 椰子壳破开的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: The sound of a coconut cracking is my favorite.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，又犹豫地放下。
lines.en: I raise my claw, then put it down, unsure.

lines.zh: 这么香的东西，你舍得给我？
lines.en: Something this fragrant — you'd give it to me?

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，沙沙作响。
lines.en: I shuffle forward half a step, sand hissing.

lines.zh: 别伸手，扔过来就行。
lines.en: Don't reach out; just toss it over.

lines.zh: 我盯着那东西，眼睛都直了。
lines.en: I stare at it until my eyes go still.

lines.zh: 撞上我的壳，你会先退。
lines.en: Hit my shell and you'll be the one recoiling.

lines.zh: 我横着让开，腿有点乱。
lines.en: I sidestep out of the way, legs tangled.

lines.zh: 壳沿磕到你的腿，抱歉。
lines.en: My shell's rim caught your leg — sorry.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你差点踩到我。
lines.en: I'm this low; you nearly stepped on me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙子溅起来。
lines.en: We knock together and sand sprays up.

lines.zh: 我的钳子挡在身前，不是要夹你。
lines.en: My claw is up front, not to pinch you.

lines.zh: 退一步，我的壳能撞疼人。
lines.en: One step back; my shell can bruise.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的影子，就停住了。
lines.en: I step on your shadow and stop.

lines.zh: 这壳比看着沉，撞得也实。
lines.en: This shell is heavier than it looks, and hits hard.

lines.zh: 你踢起的沙落进我的壳里。
lines.en: Sand you kicked up falls inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我把最大的椰子壳让给她。
lines.en: I offer her the largest coconut shell.

lines.zh: 两只蟹钳轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: Two claws touch, very lightly.

lines.zh: 她在沙上横着走，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She walks sideways; I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我们夹着同一根椰叶，谁也不松。
lines.en: We grip the same palm frond; neither lets go.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我们一起去捡食。
lines.en: The tide is out; we go scavenge together.

lines.zh: 她的壳花纹比我的好看。
lines.en: Her shell pattern is prettier than mine.

lines.zh: 我敲了三下壳，她回了两下。
lines.en: I tap my shell three times; she answers twice.

lines.zh: 两只椰子蟹并排趴着，像两块石头。
lines.en: Two coconut crabs side by side, like two stones.

lines.zh: 以后这片沙滩，我们一起守。
lines.en: From now on, we guard this beach together.

lines.zh: 等卵孵出来，它们自己会往海里走。
lines.en: When the eggs hatch, they'll find the sea alone.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹起它，稳稳的。
lines.en: I pick it up with my claw, steady.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我的钳子不在乎。
lines.en: That weight means nothing to my claw.

lines.zh: 我把壳里塞满了，走路都晃。
lines.en: I've stuffed my shell full and stagger when I walk.

lines.zh: 碎椰子片要留着当垫子。
lines.en: Bits of coconut shell will do as bedding.

lines.zh: 我夹着东西，就不再爬高了。
lines.en: Holding something, I won't climb any higher.

lines.zh: 这件小东西，抵得上半条鱼。
lines.en: This little thing is worth half a fish.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前看了看。
lines.en: I lift it before my eyes to inspect.

lines.zh: 钳子一松，东西就掉进壳缝。
lines.en: My claw loosens and it drops into a shell crack.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都归我的壳。
lines.en: Whatever I find goes into my shell.

lines.zh: 我夹得很紧，你拿不走。
lines.en: I'm holding it tight; you can't take it.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，我听见了。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I heard it.

lines.zh: 浪线上有个白点，是贝壳吗？
lines.en: A white speck on the foam line — a shell?

lines.zh: 有只小蟹钻进洞里去了。
lines.en: A small crab has ducked into a hole.

lines.zh: 椰子树下掉了个东西。
lines.en: Something fell beneath the coconut palm.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，朝那个方向。
lines.en: I raise my claw toward that direction.

lines.zh: 那味道很腥，离得不远。
lines.en: That smell is fishy, and close by.

lines.zh: 我看见沙面上有细小的气泡。
lines.en: I see tiny bubbles on the sand's surface.

lines.zh: 有什么在翻动我的壳边。
lines.en: Something is nudging the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 它的影子落在我的钳子上。
lines.en: Its shadow falls across my claw.

lines.zh: 我用触须探了探，确认是活的。
lines.en: I test the air with my feelers; it's alive.

lines.zh: 我横着挪过去，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I crab sideways, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 它退一寸，我进一步。
lines.en: It retreats an inch; I advance one.

lines.zh: 钳子已经张开了，就等它出来。
lines.en: My claw is open; I wait for it to emerge.

lines.zh: 潮水在往上涨，我得快点。
lines.en: The tide is coming in; I need to be quick.

lines.zh: 我贴住沙面，壳压低了些。
lines.en: I hug the sand and lower my shell.

lines.zh: 它的洞有两个出口，我守一个。
lines.en: Its burrow has two exits; I guard one.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，腿都没动。
lines.en: I've stared a long while without moving a leg.

lines.zh: 沙粒滑下去，它要出来了。
lines.en: Grains slip down; it's about to come out.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，那儿更好下手。
lines.en: I circle to the side — better angle there.

lines.zh: 再等一浪，就动手。
lines.en: One more wave, then I move.

lines.zh: 钳子一合，声音像折断树枝。
lines.en: My claw snaps, like a branch breaking.

lines.zh: 我夹住就不松，看你怎么办。
lines.en: I clamp down and don't let go; now what?

lines.zh: 八条腿撑住地，我往前推。
lines.en: Eight legs braced, I shove forward.

lines.zh: 壳是我的盾，我顶着撞过去。
lines.en: My shell is a shield; I charge behind it.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了钳子的力气。
lines.en: That one took everything my claw has.

lines.zh: 我敲在它的壳上，手都麻了。
lines.en: I strike its shell and my claw goes numb.

lines.zh: 再进一步，我就剪断它。
lines.en: One step closer and I'll cut it.

lines.zh: 我把它掀翻，翻过来就好办。
lines.en: I flip it over — on its back it's easier.

lines.zh: 海水溅起来，我趁机扑上。
lines.en: Seawater splashes up, and I lunge through it.

lines.zh: 打不动就退，我懂得这个。
lines.en: If it won't break, I retreat; I know that much.

lines.zh: 我从一颗熟透的椰子里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a ripe coconut.

lines.zh: 壳还没干，沙已经粘上了。
lines.en: My shell isn't dry, and sand already sticks.

lines.zh: 海在那边，我听得见浪。
lines.en: The sea is over there; I hear the waves.

lines.zh: 第一次横着走，腿还不听话。
lines.en: My first sideways walk — my legs won't obey.

lines.zh: 椰肉的甜味还在嘴里。
lines.en: The sweetness of coconut flesh is still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我挑了块最大的壳背上。
lines.en: I picked the biggest shell and put it on.

lines.zh: 沙子太亮，我的眼睛缩了缩。
lines.en: The sand is bright; my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 海浪打湿我的第一条腿。
lines.en: A wave wets my very first leg.

lines.zh: 这片海滩没人，正好归我。
lines.en: This beach is empty — just right for me.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，对着太阳张了张。
lines.en: I raise my claw and open it at the sun.

lines.zh: 壳被烧得发烫，我只能往前跑。
lines.en: My shell burns hot; I can only run forward.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上翻下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I tumble off the rock; the shell lands first.

lines.zh: 海水漫过壳沿，我往里缩。
lines.en: Seawater rises past my shell's rim; I shrink inside.

lines.zh: 壳被震得嗡嗡响，我头晕。
lines.en: The blast sets my shell ringing; my head spins.

lines.zh: 箭扎在壳上，弹开了半截。
lines.en: An arrow struck my shell and broke in half.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进壳缝，我发抖。
lines.en: A cold feeling seeps through a crack; I shiver.

lines.zh: 壳重走得慢，我很久没吃东西。
lines.en: My shell slows me down and I haven't eaten in days.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙滩上，沙结成了块。
lines.en: Lightning hits the beach and the sand fuses.

lines.zh: 壳再硬，也挡不住这种下坠。
lines.en: No shell is hard enough for a fall like this.
